questiontext.text: Which of the following are cultural methods of weed control? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Mulching, cover cropping, and crop rotation are cultural methods. Spraying Paraquat is chemical control.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are negative environmental consequences of frequent agricultural bush burning? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Burning destroys soil organisms, depletes humus, and causes air pollution. It does not destroy deep rhizomes.
